notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm happy to announce that we are releasing From Beyond from Early Access!
Why was this done? Well, the main point of the game, that being the story, is completely implemented with this update, so I decided that it would be a good time to release the game.

Because this is a sudden update, I'll keep the price of the game the same for one week. Afterwards, it will be increased a bit to fit the amount of time that the game takes to complete.

While at it, why not join our socials to receive information about the works on the old and new projects in the series?
Our Discord : https://discord.gg/jWYRk5399W

Our Twitter/X : https://x.com/WCoMF_Project

Our YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/@WCoMFProject

notes.title: Update 2: Ryn Route
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Just after I made the announcement yesterday, the problems with verification were cleared up!
So what do we have here? 
[list]
[*] A fully implemented route
[*] Updated bits and pieces of old text
[*] It's worth redoing past routes now because new pieces of dialogue will change here and there depending on which routes you've cleared
[*] The route comes with a batch of new art
[/list]

So, what's next? I think it'll be important for me to take a rest for the remaining part of 2024, though I'm sure that I'll be working on other pieces within the project anyway.
The next few updates should be focusing more on QoL, gui etc, but it's also possible that I'll just add the complete ending first. Whatever I end up doing, it should bring us closer to a more completed game.

As for the page on itch, it should be set up soon, so more information will follow.

Happy holidays,
The WCoMF Team

notes.title: Update(n't) 2 and Where it is
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I wanted to surprice everyone by releasing the update on the 22st of December, about two days before the announced date, so that everyone would be able to take their time with the new route. The reality is, however, that I can't release the update due to hiccups with Steam verification. I talked about the issue with Steam but we got nowhere so far, so I'm still waiting and hoping that it'll solve by itself, but I wonder if it will...

That's why I'll make a page one itch as well!
More information about that will be available soon.

With that being said, I want to send a big 'thank you' to everyone who purchased the game so far! During the sale so far, we have more than doubled the amount of sales. I couldn't have asked for a better gift for Christmas, to be honest.
The sale is going to continue for another week, so please tell your friends about this game as I'd love to share the stories of the world of WCoMF with as many people as possible.

So, tldr: the update is there, but I can't release it due to difficulties with Steam verifications. I'm working on it, but there will be a page on itch because of that. I'm also very thankful for everyone who bought the game and hope that everyone enjoys the stories that we create.

Thanks again, 
Merry Chrismas and a Happy New Year,

The WCoMF Team
